# BenchmarkingSuite

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A collection of standardized tasks, datasets, and metrics designed to evaluate and compare learning algorithms in a controlled manner. Facilitates objective comparison of local learning rules, guiding hardware-software co-optimization in TCC/iNEST systems.
